report.summary: UPI checkout timeouts were caused by severe latency degradation on partner-bank-api, which exhausted worker pools on upi-gateway and triggered cascading 10-second timeout errors on payments-api.

supporting.note: upi-gateway worker pool exhausted waiting on partner-bank-api
upi-gateway latency spiked dramatically starting at 13:43
payments-api timed out calling upi-gateway POST /v2/collect
payments-api latency jumped to ~9s starting at 13:45
Past incident shows similar symptom signature during partner bank degradation

ranked_hypotheses.title: Internal Code Deploy or Config Change

contradicting.note: No deployments found for payments-api or upi-gateway in the 24-hour window

facts.text: payments-api p99 latency jumped from ~380ms to over 10s starting at 2026-10-04T13:45:00+00:00.
payments-api error rate jumped to ~11% starting at 2026-10-04T13:47:00+00:00.
payments-api logged timeout errors calling upi-gateway POST /v2/collect after 10000ms.
upi-gateway reported worker pool exhausted (200/200 busy) with most workers waiting on partner-bank-api.
No deployments occurred for payments-api or upi-gateway in the past 24 hours.

assumptions: External telemetry accurately reflects degradation on partner-bank-api since direct server logs are absent.
evidence_gaps: Lack of direct server-side logs and metrics from external vendor partner-bank-api.
Partial log shard timeout during query_logs for upi-gateway.

timeline.event: upi-gateway p99 latency starts spiking above baseline.
payments-api logs first 10-second timeout error calling upi-gateway.
payments-api and upi-gateway error rates spike to ~11%.
upi-gateway logs worker pool exhaustion waiting on partner-bank-api.
Incident INC-03 reported by on-call SRE Kabir.

recommended_actions.action: Notify partner bank operations team regarding ongoing degradation and request status on partner-bank-api.
recommended_actions.rationale: The root cause originates in the external partner bank API.

recommended_actions.action: Enable or lower circuit breaker thresholds on upi-gateway to fast-fail requests during partner bank degradation.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents worker pool exhaustion and cascading request pile-ups inside upi-gateway and payments-api.

recommended_actions.action: Implement fallback routing to alternative partner banks or payment gateways.
recommended_actions.rationale: Maintains customer transaction success rates when primary partner APIs fail.
